rule: Lend the borrowed projector only with permission from its owner.
facts: Its owner has given written permission for this loan.
The person requesting the projector says the owner probably would not mind. The owner has not given permission.

rule: Treat matching instrument readings as independent corroboration only when they come from independent measurements.
facts: Two dashboards show the same temperature, but both copy the value from one thermometer.
Two independently calibrated thermometers measured the temperature and logged their values separately.

rule: Use the poll to draw a preliminary conclusion about the whole group only if everyone in the group had an equal chance to be invited.
facts: Each member was entered once into a random draw for invitations.
Each person who came to the committee meeting was entered once into a random draw for invitations. Other members could not be drawn.

rule: Publish a contributor's revised statement only after the contributor approves the actual wording of the revision.
facts: The contributor signed off on the draft. The disputed sentence was rewritten after that approval.
The disputed sentence was rewritten, then the contributor signed off on the revised document containing it.

rule: The archive counts a restored clock as the same artifact if its original mechanism survives. The case is not used to establish identity.
facts: The clock was rebuilt in a new case, retaining its original mechanism.
The clock's original case was retained. Its mechanism was replaced with a replica.

rule: Use a notice as evidence that the audience knew the rule only if the notice was delivered before the action at issue.
facts: The audience received the notice the morning after the action.
The audience received the notice the morning before the action.

rule: Allow a participant to withdraw their identifiable interview while it is still possible to locate that interview.
facts: The interview has been mixed into an unlabeled audio archive. The linking index is intact and identifies it precisely.
The interview has been mixed into an unlabeled audio archive. The linking index is destroyed and there is no remaining way to identify it.

rule: Grant the late application exception only if the applicant submitted on time and the platform caused the delay.
facts: The applicant started early, but submitted after the deadline. The platform was working throughout.
The applicant submitted before the deadline and has a timestamp. The platform did not deliver it until the next day.

rule: Display the photograph only if everyone recognizable in it has consented to public display.
facts: Everyone recognizable consented. The label is printed in blue ink.
Everyone recognizable consented. The label is printed in green ink.

rule: Accept a forecast as a genuinely advance prediction only if it is on record before the outcome occurs.
facts: The forecast was entered after the result. Its spreadsheet tab is called June.
The forecast was entered after the result. Its spreadsheet tab is called Forecasts.

rule: Combine the two inventory entries only if both refer to the same serial number.
facts: Both entries have serial number H624. One was typed on a tablet.
Both entries have serial number H624. One was typed on a laptop.

rule: Identify the complainant publicly only if they have provided specific permission for public identification.
facts: They gave no such permission. They filed the complaint using an envelope.
They gave no such permission. They filed the complaint using an online form.
